meta.source_title_note: All 171 rules cite the single title 'Dale — Indian Palmistry', matching the KB's existing 'Cheiro — Palmistry for All' Author — Title convention. The lab batch shipped 164 rules as 'Indian Palmistry' and the 7 chunk-012 re-extraction rules (PALM-DALE-165..171) as 'Dale — Indian Palmistry'. That split matters: engine.ts buildClusters derives `agreement` from the SET of source texts and pays AGREEMENT_BONUS_PER_SOURCE (15%) per extra book, so one book under two titles would have manufactured agreement=2 in every cluster holding rules from both groups.

Baaya haath (left) woh anubhav dikhata hai jo beet chuke hain ya abhi beet rahe hain. Mahilaon ke liye yeh ulta samjha jaata hai — baaya haath bhavishya ka aur daaya haath ateet ka sanket karta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Hand to Examine — male right positive, female converse

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Sun line clearly present ho aur color saaf aur achha ho, to yeh sanket deta hai ki aapko samaj mein izzat aur recognition milti hai. Log aapko wise aur upright samajhte hain. Yeh ek bahut achha sanket hai jo favour aur grace deta hai, aksar powerful logon se bhi.

sources.loc: Sec. Brilliancy, etc — Via Solis uniform and clear colour gives favour and grace

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Sun line confused ya afflicted dikhe, to yeh sanket deta hai ki powerful ya authoritative logon se tension ya virodh aa sakta hai. Yeh ek phase hai jo aata-jaata hai — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai patience aur diplomacy se. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

sources.loc: Sec. Brilliancy, etc — Via Solis confused and afflicted brings trouble from powerful men

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Via Lasciva (Via Lactea) line saaf aur ek-jaisi ho, toh yeh sanket deta hai ki samudri aur zamini safar mein achhi kismat aur safalta milti hai. Yeh line graceful soch aur composed baat-cheet ka bhi ishara karti hai. Mounts.venus ka unafflicted hona in qualities ko aur strengthen karta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Via Lactea — line uniformly composed, proportionate and continued

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Agar Via Lasciva line cut ya distorted ho, toh yeh ek phase of difficulty ka sanket de sakti hai — kuch pareshaaniyan aur alag-alag areas mein challenges aa sakte hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai; is par dhyan dekar aur soch-samajhkar kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Via Lactea — line cut or distorted

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Via Lasciva line saaf ho aur Mercury finger ki taraf upar uthti ho, toh yeh bahut acchi kismat aur khushi ka sanket deta hai — especially safaron mein. Yeh combination aapki zindagi mein sukoon aur prosperity ke avsar laata hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Via Lactea — whole, ascending towards little finger sign of great happiness

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Kisi bhi mount par gridiron ya grille ka nishaan milna us mount ki shakti ko kamzor karta hai. Yeh sanket deta hai ki us mount se judi qualities mein rukawat aa sakti hai, lekin is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai aur insaan apni mehnat se in baadhaaon ko door kar sakta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — planets unfortunate when gridiron marks on mounts

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ke mount par ek saaf star ka nishaan milna bahut shubh maana jaata hai. Yeh sanket deta hai ki vyakti mein pyaar, sundarata aur kala ke prati gehri ruchiyan hain. Rishton mein warmth aur sincerity aksar inka khaas gun hota hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — Venus dignified with clear star on mount

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ka mount jab ubhra hua aur majboot ho, toh yeh ek khushmijaaj, pyaar karne waala aur kalapremi swabhaav dikhata hai. Aisi logon mein sangeet, sundarata aur mitrata ke liye gehri chahat hoti hai. Yeh ek achha sign hai — dosti aur rishton mein sachchi warmth aksar inhein khaas banati hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — mount of Venus strong and full description

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ka mount majboot hone par vyakti sangeet, kala, teaching ya creative trades mein zyada safalta pa sakta hai. Yeh sanket deta hai ki inki natural abilities creatively oriented fields mein khilti hain. Agar abhi koi aisa kaam nahi kar rahe, toh is direction mein sochna faydemand ho sakta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — Venus mount professions: musicians, merchants, teachers

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ka mount jab bahut flat ya kamzor ho, toh yeh kabhi kabhi ek alag, thoda door-se-logon-se rehne waala ya udaas swabhaav ki taraf ishara kar sakta hai. Aksar aise logon ko apni emotional expression mein kuch mehnat lagti hai, lekin yeh sthayi nahi hai — awareness se rishton mein warmth layi ja sakti hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — Venus mount flat and void description — source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ka mount jab beech ki strength mein ho — na bahut zyada ubhra, na bilkul flat — toh ek balanced emotional aur social nature dikhata hai. Yeh log pyaar aur kala ki qadar karte hain bina kisi extreme ke. Yeh ek achha santulan hai jo rishton mein stability deta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Rule to Tell the Planets — Venus mount moderate strength

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury mount ka mazboot hona ek valorous aur strong character ka sanket deta hai. Yeh vyakti apne kaam mein daring aur determined hote hain. Yeh ek tendency hai, koi fixed fate nahi — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Little Finger — strong Mercury mount indicates valorous person

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chhoti ungli ka lambaa hona ek confident aur expressive speaker ka sanket deta hai. Yeh vyakti apne vichar clearly communicate karne mein kaafi capable hote hain. Yeh ek naturally gifted quality hai jo career aur relationships dono mein kaam aati hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Little Finger — right line from mount of Mercury to end of finger indicates great speaker

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Haath ki bahari taraf se Mercury mount tak jaane wali choti aur faint lines rishton mein kuch complexity ka sanket de sakti hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — in patterns ko samajhna aur rishton mein conscious effort karna bahut kaam aata hai. Yeh ek tendency hai, koi naseeb nahi.

sources.loc: Sec. The Little Finger — small lines from outermost part of hand to mount of Mercury indicate marriage partners — source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab chhoti ungli ring finger ke aakhri joint tak nahi pahunchti, toh yeh sanket deta hai ki partnership mein power dynamics thodi unbalanced ho sakti hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — is awareness ke saath rishton mein open communication aur boundaries banane par kaam kiya ja sakta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Little Finger — little finger not reaching last joint of ring finger indicates imperious partner — source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Palmistry mein mounts ke upar achhe aur saaf signs good omens ka sanket dete hain, jabki broken ya confused marks difficulties ki taraf ishara karte hain. Lekin ek sign akela poori tasveer nahi dikhata — doosri lines aur signs milkar reading ko balance karti hain. Poori haath ki reading mein sabhi elements ko saath dekhna chahiye.

sources.loc: Sec. The Little Finger — mounts with good figures show good omens; confused marks show contrary unless restrained by good lines

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Sun line saaf, seedhi aur achhi tarah se coloured ho, yeh sanket deta hai ki aapko bade aur prabhavshali logon ka samarthan milega. Career mein izzat aur khushi ke mauke aksar aate hain aise haath mein. Yeh ek bahut shubh sanket hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Via Solis — Sun line straight, uniformly composed, well coloured

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Sun line katri-phati ya uneven ho, toh career ke raaste mein rukavaten aur dushmani ka samna ho sakta hai. Yeh koi tay shuda baat nahi hai — is par dhyan dekar aur sahi logon ka saath leke halat sudhare ja sakte hain. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Via Solis — Sun line dissected and uneven

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Mars ki line saaf aur clearly red dikhe, toh yeh aapki exceptional drive aur determination ko darshata hai. Aap challenging situations mein bhi apni energy maintain kar sakte hain. Yeh sanket deta hai ki aap competition aur struggle mein kaafi strong rehte hain.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Mars. Courage and Fortitude — clear and red Mars line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Mars line Life line ke saath milkar saaf aur gehri dono lines dikh rahi hain, toh yeh ek dohra suraksha kavach ki tarah hai jo aapki urja aur fortitude ko badhata hai. Is combination mein aapki Life line ki har acchi cheez aur bhi strengthen ho jaati hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai agar aap apna khayal rakhen toh yeh energy aur bhi nikharta hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Mars. Courage and Fortitude — Mars line strengthens life line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Saturn ungli par saman aur spaasht rekhaayein metals aur material pursuits mein safalta ka sanket deti hain. sources.loc: Sec. The Middle Finger — equal lines on Saturn finger indicating success with metals; feature approximated as saturn finger length since no dedicated 'finger line marks' feature exists

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab Line of Fortune (heart line) lambi aur saaf ho, bina kisi toote ya tedhi jagah ke, yeh sanket deta hai ki shareerik shakti aur manobal dono achhe hain. Zindagi mein ek tarah ki sthirta aur dridh-nischay ka bhav rehta hai. Yeh ek positive nishani hai jo overall wellbeing ko favour karti hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab yeh rekha choti ya tedhi ho, yeh sanket deta hai ki shareerik aur mansik sthirta mein kuch kami ho sakti hai. Yeh koi pakki baat nahi — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai, aur dhyan dene se yeh sthiti badal sakti hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab heart line se Jupiter ke mount ki taraf choti shaakhaein nikalti hain, yeh sanket deta hai ki samman aur izzat milne ke achhe mauke aate hain. Mehnat aur sahi disha se yeh sambhavna aur bhi zyada ho jaati hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune — branch to Jupiter mount

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab heart line sirf Jupiter par sada hui ho aur koi achha nishaan ya shaakh na ho, yeh sanket deta hai ki dhan aur samriddhi mein takleef aa sakti hai. Lekin yeh ek sanket hai, ek taraf dhyan dene ka — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai aur paristhiti badal sakti hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune — simple line on Jupiter, no marks

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Heart line ka bilkul na hona ek bahut hi unusual nishani hai jo yeh sanket deta hai ki rishton mein ya bharose ke mamle mein mushkilein ho sakti hain. Yeh koi tay shuda baat nahi — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai, aur apne swabhav ko samajhna pehla qadam hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune — absence of the line — source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab heart line mein choti choti ched-khaani wali ya confused rekhaein dikhen, yeh sanket deta hai ki kuch daur mein thakaan ya bimari ka ehsaas ho sakta hai. Yeh ek chetaavni ki tarah hai — sehat ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai, par yeh koi pakki takdeer nahi. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

sources.loc: Sec. The Line of Fortune — confused little lines denoting sickness — source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab liver line (health line) aur heart line ka aapas mein ek teekha angle banata chhota nishaan dikhe, yeh sanket deta hai ki kisi mushkil daur mein andar ki shakti par zyada dabaav pad sakta hai. Dhyan aur dekhbhaal se is sthiti ko sambhala ja sakta hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.
